solves.reasoning: 원문: family moved to Seattle, majored in history, earned a doctoral degree. (A)moved (B)majored (C)earned → ch[1]
원문: graduated from Roosevelt HS, developed an interest, was awarded Nobel Prize. (A)graduated (B)developed (C)awarded → ch[2]
원문: taught at CMU, returning to U of Chicago, very influential economist. (A)taught (B)returning (C)influential → ch[3]
④expelled는 graduated의 반의어. 원문에서 Roosevelt HS를 '졸업했다(graduated)'고 했으므로 expelled(퇴학당하다)는 부적절. ①born ②awarded ③developed 모두 원문과 일치.
②departing는 returning의 반의어. 원문 'before returning to the University of Chicago'에서 '돌아온 것'이므로 departing(떠나다)은 부적절. ①moved ③earned ④known 원문 일치.
③negligible(하찮은)은 influential(영향력 있는)의 반의어. 원문 'very influential economist'에서 negligible은 부적절. ①taking ②majored ④taught 원문 일치.
빈칸 '________ from Roosevelt High School' → graduated from + 학교명. ch[1]=graduated
빈칸 'he ________ an interest in economics' → develop an interest in (~에 관심을 키우다). ch[4]=developed
빈칸 'become a ________ of economics' → professor of economics (경제학 교수가 되었다). ch[3]=professor
earned(취득하다)의 동의어 → obtained(획득하다). ch[1]=obtained. (lost=반의어, desired=원하다, rejected=거부하다)
influential(영향력 있는)의 동의어 → significant(중요한/영향력 있는). ch[4]=significant. (minor=사소한=반의어, ordinary=평범한, unknown=알려지지 않은)
awarded(수상하다)의 동의어 → granted(수여하다). ch[2]=granted. (refused=거부하다=반의어, presented=발표, withdrawn=철회)
moved(이사하다)의 반의어 → remained(머물다). ch[4]=remained. (traveled=여행=유사, shifted=옮기다=유사, relocated=이전=동의어)
returning(돌아오다)의 반의어 → departing(떠나다). ch[1]=departing. (coming back=동의어, arriving=도착=유사, approaching=접근)
(A) doctoral degree → degree = 학위. (B) degree of his influence → degree = 정도. ch[2]='(A) 학위 — (B) 정도'
'having great influence or impact on others' = influential(영향력 있는). ch[3]=influential. (industrial=산업의, individual=개인의, intentional=의도적인)
'he was __________ (award) the Nobel Prize' → 수동태 be+p.p. → award의 과거분사 = awarded
'After __________ (take) economic history courses' → After + 전치사 뒤 동명사 → take의 동명사 = taking
'he developed __________' → develop an interest in economics(경제학에 관심을 키웠다). 버클리 경제사 수업 후 경제학 관심 형성이라는 인과관계. ch[3]='an interest in economics'
'He was known as __________' → a very influential economist(매우 영향력 있는 경제학자). 노벨상 수상자를 알려진 방식 묘사. ch[1]='a very influential economist'
